name: PinPinMe Content Connector for Pinterest
author: PinPinMe

sections.description:
PinPinMe adds a small native settings page to WordPress. It does not embed an iframe. After you connect your PinPinMe account, the plugin synchronizes the public content you enable so you can browse it as cards, search and filter it, ignore items, and create Pinterest-ready drafts on pinpinme.com.

One plugin supports both:

  • Published WordPress posts and pages.
  • Published parent WooCommerce products, including public prices, stock status, categories, and product images.

Connection and content synchronization are free. Creating a new PinPinMe draft uses the AI credits included with your PinPinMe plan. Synchronization never creates pins automatically and never spends AI credits.

External service

This plugin connects to the PinPinMe software-as-a-service platform at https://pinpinme.com. The service is required for account connection, catalog storage, Pinterest-ready draft creation, scheduling, and other PinPinMe functionality.

When an administrator explicitly connects the plugin, it sends:

  • The public site URL and site name, an installation UUID, WordPress/plugin versions, and whether WooCommerce is active.
  • Enabled published, non-password-protected post/page titles, excerpts or cleaned text, public URLs, featured images, categories, tags, and publication dates.
  • Enabled published parent WooCommerce product names, descriptions, public URLs, prices, currency, SKU, stock state, categories, and public images.

It does not synchronize drafts, private/password-protected content, orders, customers, coupons, customer or WordPress-user email fields, WordPress user records, passwords, or WooCommerce product variations as separate items.

Data is sent only after an administrator approves the connection. Disconnecting requests connector revocation and removal of imported catalog data from PinPinMe while preserving Pinterest drafts already created there. Uninstalling makes the same best-effort request and always removes all local PinPinMe plugin data from WordPress.

  • PinPinMe Terms of Service: https://pinpinme.com/terms
  • PinPinMe Privacy Policy: https://pinpinme.com/privacy

Privacy

The plugin stores a random installation UUID, encrypted connection secret, synchronization preferences, status metadata, and a temporary local outbox in the WordPress database. Temporary authorization codes expire after ten minutes. Signed control requests expire after five minutes and are replay-protected.

See the detailed external-service disclosure above and the PinPinMe Privacy Policy at https://pinpinme.com/privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pinpinme folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate PinPinMe. Activation performs no external request.
  3. Open PinPinMe in WordPress Admin.
  4. Choose the public content types to synchronize and click Connect PinPinMe.
  5. Sign in or create an account on pinpinme.com, approve the site, and return to WordPress.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin embed PinPinMe in WordPress?

No. The settings page is native WordPress UI. Open PinPinMe opens the service in a separate browser tab.

Does connecting cost anything?

Connection, automatic synchronization, catalog cards, search, filters, and Ignore/Restore are free. Creating a new draft uses one AI credit under the limits of your PinPinMe plan.

What happens if WooCommerce is not installed?

WordPress post and page synchronization continues normally. The PinPinMe WooCommerce view reports that WooCommerce is not detected.

Which WooCommerce features are supported?

The connector reads published products through WooCommerce public APIs and does not read or write orders. It is compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and does not alter the cart or checkout flow.

Are orders or customer records sent?

No. Orders, customers, coupons, their email fields, private content, credentials, and WordPress user records are excluded. As with any content connector, text intentionally published inside an enabled post, page, or product is part of that public content.

What happens when I deactivate the plugin?

Background jobs stop, but connection details are preserved so activation can resume syncing. Use Disconnect or uninstall the plugin to revoke the connection.
